entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: Avatar into which the Otarian barbarian Jeska was turned by the Cabal Patriarch's curse.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Fought Phage in the Grand Coliseum.

entities.name: Kamhal
entities.description: Tried to stop the duel with Soul Reaper.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: Intervened and was slain by the attack.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Living incarnation of magic, reborn from the aggregation of the three women.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A creature from the Blood Age summoned by Extus Narr during the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Created the five Overlords of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Kaldra
entities.description: Avatar created by the unification of the Kaldra artifacts.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Assembled the Kaldra artifacts to dispatch Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Took control of Kaldra and turned it against Glissa.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Became a dragon avatar as the new Living Guildpact of Ravnica.

entities.name: Gishath
entities.description: Dinosaur avatar embodying all three aspects of the Threefold Sun.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Primordial essence of all dragons in the Multiverse.

events.summary: Jeska is cursed by the Cabal Patriarch and becomes the avatar Phage the Untouchable.
events.quote: Otarian barbarian Jeska was cursed by the Cabal Patriarch inadvertently turning her into the avatar Phage the Untouchable .

events.summary: Kamhal's Soul Reaper slays Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, leading to the rebirth of Karona.
events.quote: leading Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka to all be slain by the attack.

events.summary: Extus Narr summons the Blood Avatar during the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven.
events.quote: Extus Narr summoned a creature from the Blood Age known as the Blood Avatar .

events.summary: Memnarch takes control of the Kaldra avatar and turns it against Glissa.
events.quote: he took control of the avatar and turned it against her.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet, resurrected during Operation Desperation, becomes a dragon avatar as Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet became a dragon avatar as the new Living Guildpact of Ravnica.
